conviction_note: Event is confirmed real (company release 2026-08-26). Baseline gives no option chain and no skew, so there is nothing priced to lean against; I size off the 2.5% median reaction, widened because the one prior analogue for this exact event type (FY-preliminary plus new-year guidance, 2025-09-10) moved -10.15%. Net -2.0 = a 9.8% holder's Rule 144 selling programme resuming on 2026-09-02 after a month out of the market (-1.5), the audited FY26 GAAP profit promise resting entirely on an unseen Q4 that is also the annual goodwill-impairment-test quarter (-0.7), and a two-sided FY2027/three-year guide that must absorb ~12% Bank Zero dilution (-0.5), against no offsetting positive I could evidence beyond the FX translation tailwind already visible in the company's own ZAR-versus-USD disclosure.

findings.finding: IFC's fund ALAC filed a fresh Form 144 on 2026-09-01 to sell a further 857,362 LSAK shares (exactly the Rule 144 1%-of-outstanding cap, ~10.3x the baseline 20-day ADV of 83,297) starting 2026-09-02 through J.P. Morgan, after selling 857,362 shares between 2026-06-08 and 2026-08-07 and 808,737 shares between 2026-03-05 and 2026-04-17 — i.e. the seller was capped out and absent from the tape from 2026-08-08 to 2026-09-01 and returns to it in the same week as the print.
findings.why_not_priced: International Finance Corp stopped filing Form 4s on 2026-04-16 because the IFC group fell to 9.84% of the class (Schedule 13D/A, 2026-06-17: 3,271,862 + 1,856,263 + 3,302,551 = 8,430,676 shares), so every insider-transaction screen that feeds Benzinga/MarketBeat/Fintel now shows LSAK with no insider selling for five months while 771k+ shares were in fact distributed after 22 June. The last 20 sessions of tape carry no information about this supply at all, because ALAC's own filing shows it made zero sales between 08/07 and the 09/01 refiling. If the market had it, you would see it in the positioning: short interest is 0.28% of shares out and total option open interest in the baseline is 115 contracts with a put/call OI ratio of 0.01 — there is literally no expression of a supply overhang in the price. Mechanism into the measurement window: a 144 programme worked as a percentage of volume puts its largest absolute supply on the highest-volume session of the quarter, which is the reaction session.
findings.independence: Corroborated by a different filing type from the same filer family — Schedule 13D/A Amendment No. 5 discloses 671,112 shares sold by ALAC between 2026-03-18 and 2026-06-17 at $4.65-$5.44 across 24 dates (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1041514/000119312526274718/0001193125-26-274718.txt, 2026-06-17), and the Form 4 by International Finance Corp dated 2026-04-13 confirms the same entity was a Section 16 insider until April (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1041514/000119312526153395/0001193125-26-153395-index.htm). These are one source cluster — same seller, three filing types — and should be collapsed as such; nothing from an unrelated party points the same way.

findings.finding: Nine-month FY2026 GAAP net loss attributable to Lesaka is -$461 thousand (nine months to 2026-03-31, per the company's own Q3 statement of operations), so management's repeated promise of 'the first year we will be profitable since the creation of Lesaka four years ago' rests entirely on Q4 FY26 clearing +$0.46m — in the quarter that carries the 30 June annual goodwill impairment test on R3,532,856 thousand (~$207m) of goodwill against $186.6m of total equity.
findings.why_not_priced: Exactly one Wall Street analyst publishes a target on LSAK ($8 against a $4.57 spot), so there is no published GAAP net-income consensus for the wire to compare the print against and no model that has done this addition in public. The 'delivers on guidance' framing has been repeated all year and is what the coverage reflects; if the market had focused on the arithmetic it would treat 'net income: positive' as a Q4-dependent binary rather than as banked, and you would see some downside hedging — instead put open interest is effectively nil. Lesaka has produced a negative year-end accounting surprise in each of the last two cycles (FY2025: $49.3m MobiKwik loss plus $18.4m impairments and an agent-to-principal revenue restatement disclosed with the FY25 preliminary; and a headline-earnings restatement filed 2026-05-18), and Q3 FY26 alone already absorbed ~ZAR 104m of impairments and one-offs.
findings.independence: Separate document, separate filer: the 2026-05-18 8-K/SENS correcting previously published Q3 FY2026 headline earnings (Q3 FY2025 restated from a $(5,391)k to a $(22,362)k headline loss) evidences the recurring year-end accounting-quality issue independently of the Q3 income statement — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1041514/000106299326002769/exhibit99-1.htm, 2026-05-18.

findings.finding: Management pre-committed on the 2026-05-07 Q3 call that tonight's release carries FY2027 guidance plus a first-ever three-year medium-term outlook 'inclusive of Bank Zero' — but Bank Zero is still unclosed (long-stop extended 2026-06-11 from 2026-08-06 to 2027-01-31 with Prudential Authority and exchange-control consents outstanding, and no completion 8-K on EDGAR as of 2026-09-09), it issues ~12% of Lesaka's fully diluted shares plus up to R91m cash, and Lesaka's own framing is that Bank Zero only becomes profitable in the fiscal year AFTER completion.
findings.why_not_priced: Genuinely two-sided and I am sizing it small for that reason. Downside: FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance is ZAR 5.50-6.00 after two years of >100% and ~150% growth; 12% more shares alone takes a 30%-growth FY2027 from ~ZAR 7.4 to ~ZAR 6.6 before a loss-making bank is consolidated, so the FY27 guide can print near-flat on a stock that has been marked on a doubling cadence. Upside: a first-ever three-year outlook is a confidence-signalling device management would not volunteer into a weak plan. With one covering analyst and no published ZAR FY2027 consensus, there is no anchor either way — which is exactly why the price cannot already contain it; a market that had priced this would show a dispersion trade or at least a two-sided option chain, and the chain has 115 contracts of total open interest.
findings.independence: The unclosed status and outstanding Prudential Authority / exchange-control consents are corroborated from a different source and document — https://www.citizen.co.za/business/lesaka-pushes-bank-zero-acquisition-deadline-to-2027-as-regulatory-approvals-lag/ (2026-06-18) and the 8-K disclosing the long-stop extension (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/LSAK/8-k-lesaka-technologies-inc-reports-material-event-8d4a61395f12.html, 8-K dated 2026-06-11, accepted 2026-06-17). The FY27/medium-term-outlook commitment and the 12% dilution reading both come from the same Q3 call transcript, so treat that half as one source.

searched_and_found_nothing: JSE SENS trading statement: no 2026 trading statement for LSK found. SENS archives were unreadable or empty (sharedata.co.za News.aspx returned only chrome, sharenet sens_bycompany 404, moneyweb click-a-company 403, ir.lesakatech.com/sec-sens.php renders no list). The only 2026 SENS items surfaced by search are the Q1/Q2/Q3 results, the directors'-dealings notices, the executive-chairman compensation amendment, the 2026-05-18 headline-earnings correction and the 2026-08-26 results-date notice — no trading statement and no cautionary.
No preliminary pre-release: EDGAR submissions show no 8-K after 2026-08-03 (option-award shareholder vote) and none since, so unlike FY2025 there has been no early leak of FY2026 numbers.
No Bank Zero completion announcement as of 2026-09-09.
No officer/director Form 4 activity since 2026-04-16 — no insider buying or selling signal from management itself.
Short interest 0.28% of shares outstanding (2026-08-28) — no crowded position, no squeeze fuel, no information.

Bank Zero standalone financials: no published loss figure for a South African mutual bank of this size could be sourced, so the FY27 earnings drag could not be quantified beyond the ~12% share dilution.

No supplier, customer, franchisee, landlord or competitor gave guidance after Lesaka last spoke (2026-05-07) that bears specifically on Lesaka's April-June quarter; SA consumer-credit and fuel-shock data (inflation to 5.0% in June 2026 on the Hormuz oil shock) is macro and visible to everyone.

FX: USDZAR averaged 17.0568 across 9M FY2026 per Lesaka's own conversion note, versus roughly 18.2 in FY2025, so USD-reported revenue growth of +8.6% for 9M FY26 is almost entirely translation and underlying ZAR revenue growth is ~2%. The company discloses both currencies prominently and quoted Q3 ZAR revenue as +0.2% YoY, so this is disclosed rather than hidden and I did not file it as a finding.
App-store review volume, hiring pages, status pages and customer forums: pursued but produced no datum specific and dated enough to carry a URL.
baseline_tension: There is no skew and no implied move in the baseline to lean against (unusable chain, 115 contracts of open interest), so the only priced statement available is the -5.38% 20-day drift — and my read adds negative on top of a name that has already faded, which is the weak part of it; against that, the drift happened during the exact window (2026-08-08 to 2026-09-01) in which the 144 seller was capped out and absent, so it cannot be that supply, and the 0.01 put/call OI ratio plus 0.28% short interest say nobody is hedged for the tail that a year-end preliminary with a first-ever three-year outlook actually carries.
